hud-panel.note: KkPanel is the frame of almost every block of the example app and of the catalogue sheets. Keep its State (collapsed flag, scroll offset) and that of its child across every change of level, variant and collapse.

hud-matrix-log.note: The scroll behaviour of the package was changed by another agent (lib/src/layout/scroll.dart: every KEIKAI scroll view has its own position; a list is clamped into its content at once): read it before touching the log’s scrolling.

hud-alarms.note: KkEmergency is shown by the example app as a full-screen route (showKkEmergency) and acknowledged with Enter.

ctl-plates.note: lib/src/widgets/pressable.dart (KkPressable, KkFocusRing) is being repaired by another agent: read it as it is and do not edit it. KkButton and KkIconButton are used by every other family.

ctl-choice.note: lib/src/widgets/pressable.dart is being repaired by another agent: read it as it is and do not edit it. KkCheckbox is used by the data table, KkSegmented and KkChip by the example app.

ctl-slider.note: The example app works around one reported defect (no focus on press) with its own FocusNode; the fix must not break that.

ctl-feedback.note: KkSteppedValue (lib/src/motion/entrances.dart) keeps its clock while changes come faster than a step now: read it before touching the progress bar. KkSkeleton is used by the data table, KkEmpty and KkProgress by the example app.
